summary: Santacruz Silver Mining filed a 6-K attaching a September 8, 2026 news release disclosing conditional TSX approval to graduate its common shares from the TSX Venture Exchange. No price, stake, or transaction terms are stated; the move is a listing migration, not a special situation. Trading will continue under symbol SCZ, with voluntary TSXV delisting upon final approval; shareholders need take no action. The company will announce the commencement date separately. The risk-arb angle is index inclusion and liquidity-driven flow rather than deal spread, with timing dependent on satisfying customary TSX conditions.
